quotes.text: When adding Thunderbird Rust crates, include their linkage in Thunderbird gkrust-gtest and preserve ENABLE_TESTS/LINK_GTEST_DURING_COMPILE behavior. Product linkage alone did not make gtest-xul build with EWS. Enabling Rust in standard builds and removing temporary Rust jobs followed this dependency fix. The accepted manually mirrored upstream crate declarations carried known maintenance risk, so check them when upstream gkrust-gtest changes. Current workspace override is unconditional; do not recommend the removed2024 optout as current configuration.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
